matching_upstream_items.title: Record eight reviewed linear-system resolutions by Matthew J. Colbrook
matching_upstream_items.body:
Record eight independently reviewed resolutions by Matthew J. Colbrook from `OpenProblemsInNLA_recovered_GitHub.zip`, with verified Cambridge affiliation and preserved substantial-AI-assistance/reconstruction disclosure.

- IE-13: exact unequal-bandwidth growth recurrence, with complex all-path upper bound and real attaining matrices.
- IE-14: exact cyclic tridiagonal growth F_(n+1)+1 for every n>=4.
- IE-17: both canonical LSMR error quantities increase on one exact example. This is the matrix-only spectral-norm formulation; the historical SISC default norm convention differs, and no Frobenius conclusion is inferred.
- IE-18: the four-step Anderson identity is false, with an unbounded-underestimation family. No asymptotic-rate conclusion is claimed.
- IE-19: entrywise inverse-norm counterexample and sharp nonattained infimum 1/(alpha+m).
- IE-21 and IE-22: the spherical row-deletion limit, explicit probability bounds, and matching universal sharp constant with the exact normalization and quantifiers.
- IE-23: nonunique direct p-to-2 norm-minimizing right inverses for every 2<p<infinity, with full minimizer descriptions. Prior attribution of the smallest matrix is retained; the product objective is excluded.
- IE-15 remains Open: its related order-five rook lower bound 893/131 resolves neither requested order-three nor order-four constant.

Three independent agents checked all seven complete TeX manuscripts and the rook note against the actual canonical targets, with full source hashes. Set eight entries to Solved; retain all 203 permanent IDs, original mathematical statements, references and dated audits. Historical ratings are explicit. Agent verification is not external human peer review or formal certification, and no novelty or priority claim is made.

Validation: supplied manifest matches all 57 hashed files; all 58 original files retained. Fresh exact checks pass all six finite groups, including 60 banded constructions and 27 cyclic orders, the separate rook example and printed LSMR constants. An additional independent rational checker imports no supplied code. Seven attributed manuscripts and nine canonical PDFs compile without warnings; all 38 final pages were visually checked. Original proof-body and canonical-target preservation, local links, all permanent IDs and catalog idempotence pass. Local safeguard tests pass 15 cases; two require unavailable Windows symlink privileges (error 1314). The unchanged complete suite runs in Linux CI.

Catalog on this branch: 203 entries, 171 open targets (91 Open, 80 Partially resolved), 1 Solution claimed and 31 Solved. Eight targets leave the open count.

matching_upstream_items.title: [IE-15] Record reviewed related order-five lower bound by Matthew J. Colbrook
matching_upstream_items.body:
### Affected entry

[IE-15](https://github.com/MColbrook/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/c1cdd202d23c7386451b7d81084999f3a4f90171/linear-systems-and-elimination/IE-15/README.md).

### Correction or result

**Related order-five lower bound.** The recovered rational order-five matrix has an admissible rook path of growth 893/131. Its exact pivot and Schur-complement checks pass, with ties allowed. This does not determine either order-three or order-four constant requested by IE-15; the entry remains Open.

Proposed status: **Open; related evidence only**. Original target, permanent ID, references and dated audits are preserved.

Author: **Matthew J. Colbrook**, Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics, University of Cambridge, Cambridge, United Kingdom. [Official affiliation](https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/mjc249/home.html), checked 11 September 2026. The supplied notes and software were reconstructed with substantial AI assistance; this is disclosed in the original recovery record. The smallest IE-23 matrix is attributed to Dokmanic and Gribonval's spectral-norm example, not claimed as a new matrix construction.

### Evidence

[Complete primary proof](https://github.com/MColbrook/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/c1cdd202d23c7386451b7d81084999f3a4f90171/references/colbrook-recovered-2026-09-11/submitted/research/rook_partial.md), [full independent proof review](https://github.com/MColbrook/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/c1cdd202d23c7386451b7d81084999f3a4f90171/references/colbrook-recovered-2026-09-11/verification/reviews/rook-review.md), and [submission record](https://github.com/MColbrook/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/c1cdd202d23c7386451b7d81084999f3a4f90171/references/colbrook-recovered-2026-09-11/README.md). Links are pinned to commit `c1cdd202d23c7386451b7d81084999f3a4f90171`. Reviews identify complete source hashes, confirmed live target mappings, proof steps and scope limitations. The package's provisional identifiers were checked against the actual canonical statements.

The supplied manifest matched all 57 hashed files; all 58 original files including the manifest are retained. All six finite exact-check groups, the separate rook check, and the LSMR printed-constant audit passed fresh execution. The row-deletion theorems are supported by full analytic reviews, not finite diagnostics. Independent agent review is not external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification. No historical novelty or priority claim is made.

### Rating implications, if any

For the eight resolved targets, retain the original difficulty and importance as historical ratings and remove them from the open count. IE-15 retains its ratings and open status because its requested dimensions are unresolved.
